premises: the generated predicate is the clause (tools/ic_declarations.py writes both from one text)

obligations.statement: Unless not_null(entry), start changes nothing observable.

obligations.method: source structure: only const locals, guards and their refusals, output resets and read-only checks precede the guard in its function (and the call that relays its status)
